## 2. Material Science: Authentic Slavic Hair vs. Factory "European" Hair
Most commercial salons in Los Angeles use factory-processed hair originating from Asia or India. To mimic fine Caucasian textures, this hair is submerged in sulfuric acid baths to strip the cuticle, then coated in synthetic industrial silicone. Within 4–8 weeks, the silicone dissolves, leaving brittle, matted hair.
In contrast, Culture of Extensions exclusively works with:
- 100% genuine single-donor raw virgin Slavic and select European remy hair.
- Intact, unidirectional cuticles that lay flat, eliminating friction and matting.
- Lifespan of 12 to 24 months across multiple salon maintenance cycles.
- Natural weight-to-hair density alignment that blends flawlessly with fine-to-medium biological hair.

## 3. Installation Techniques & Biomechanics
- **Signature K-Tip Micro-Capsules**: Italian keratin polymers rolled by hand to rice-grain dimensions. Offers 360-degree freedom, undetectable hairline and crown placement, and completely tension-free attachment. Lasts 3 to 4 months between resets.
- **BIO Tape-Ins**: Medical-grade flexible adhesive tabs for quick, flat installations that do not tug on the scalp. Re-taped every 6 to 8 weeks.
- **Invisible Bead & Volume Work**: Hidden bead foundation encased between hair wefts, ensuring metal beads never touch bare scalp.
